defs.def: the way in which a piece of equipment is set to perform a particular task （设备的）模式，工作状态

ex.s: When we turn off a device, such a television, it goes into stand-by mode.
ex.t: 当我们关掉一台设备，比如电视机，它就进入了待机模式。

ex.s: Devices in this mode still use power, and older devices in stand-by mode can use even more.
ex.t: 处于这种模式的设备仍然耗电，而较旧的设备在待机模式下耗电更多。

ex.s: The future home will use integrated sensors to tell when you leave home each morning, and then go into an energy-efficient mode all by itself.
ex.t: 未来的家将使用集成传感器来判断每天早上你何时离开家，然后自动进入节能模式。

ex.s: This morning, I saw the shocking headline: “Passenger Dies When Car Crashes in Driverless Mode”.
ex.t: 今天早上，我看到了那则令人震惊的标题：“无人驾驶模式下车祸致乘客死亡”。

ex.s: At this time, your portable electronic devices must “flight mode” or until an announcement upon arrival.
ex.t: 此时，你的便携式电子设备必须______＂飞行模式＂，或直到抵达时的通知。
